notes.title: The final release build is now being uploaded!
notes.notes:
Since we released the bigger world we have pushed out small chunks of updates to fill in the gaps and now we are uploading our final release build. There are some minor bugs that are being fixed as we speak, but they shouldn't affect the game play as a whole.

We hope that this new build is available for everyone by tomorrow (it takes some time for steam to process).

This release build features:

*4 characters
*A caribbean world with islands/caves/other areas
*Enemy ships
*Build (ships etc)
*Mine (mine gold, iron)
*Quests
*Levels
*Caves
*Cannibals

Our goal was to create a game featuring building/mining/exploring and that is what this game is all about. 

I also wanted to update the first game and this new sequel is a both a new update and a new game.

However, we have decided to include a bigger story and include more items / armor and a lot of other things. But that will be included in a bigger update in a few months.


I would also like to include what I wanted to create from the start. A survival mode. 

In the end this game will feature these titles/gamemodes:

HoD franchise:

On open seas (our core game that we will focus on)
A pirate adventure ( a new pirate survival gamemode)
A ship adventure ( a new update from the old game)

notes.title: How to access the first version of 2.0
notes.notes:
If you have bought the game:

1. Locate HoD: A pirate adventure in your library

2.. Right click on the game in your library - Then go to the beta tab and select "alpha_tester", restart Steam afterwards

If you haven't bought the game:

1. Look through your mail until you see a mail from us with a beta key

2. Add the key to your Steam

3. Install the game and click play.

notes.title: Version 1.9 - The 2.0 is near..
notes.notes:
We have now updated the game to version 1.9.

Since we really want to make version 2.0 great we are also going to launch version 2.0 on all the other markets.

Markets that will be affected:

Itunes
Google Play
Windows Store
Steam

*When version 2.0 is out you will be able to play multiplayer with anyone that has the game on these devices.*

The multiplayer has been specifically designed to work with touch devices and keyboards. We are however going to include Xbox-controller support (and a couple of other devices as well).

We have also decided to remake the game from scratch on mobile devices so that it works more efficently. There has also been a couple of tweaks and rewritten scripts on the Steam-version in version 1.9.

We have tested the multiplayer features on all devices - It works great so far, video will be out soon, as well as version 2.0

notes.title: Update 1.7
notes.notes:
Update 1.7 is now up and running on all available platforms.

Windows
Mac OS X
Linux

We also have full support for 64-bit and 32-bit.

A lot of people had problems with the current build being deleted in an empty update from Steam, this will however not happen again.

We had to make a better structure of all the builds and platforms etc, it was better to do it now, we think it would have been a lot worse if we had waited with this.

notes.title: Changing some things - Update 1.7
notes.notes:
There is a new build coming up and unfortunatly it seems to have affected the current build.

Before we had three depots (Windows, Mac and Linux) with executables that were configured so they could launch in both 32/64.

However that seems to have caused problems for some people.

So we decided to create 6 depots,

Windows 32-bit
WIndows 64-bit
Linux 32-bit
Linux 64-bit
OSX 32-bit
OSX 64-bit

SInce we are uploading 6 builds right now, Steam had a little trouble figuring out which build to download since we had 3 builds before and now we have 6 builds. 

That is why Steam does not download any files right now, so if you still have the old update (the new update cleans the game on the hdd while the build is uploading) set the game so it doesn't update.

However, the builds are almost finished uploading and it should be up within an hour or so.

*The saves in the game will not be affected.
